company.description:
WEBSHOP.PARTS (AUTO.KZ)) – White-Label SAAS Platform & Ecosystem of car ownership
Our group of Companies has two main divisions — Software Development and Online agregator of automotive products. We Aggregate and processes offers from hundreds of suppliers from all over the world with a full cycle of customer service: online payment, delivery, technical support, returns, etc.
company.headquarters: Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform enabling sellers to launch and manage online shops for automotive parts and accessories with extensive product catalogs and payment integration.
productsAndServices.name: WebShop.parts SaaS Platform

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive database of automotive parts including over 70 million parts from 5,000 warehouses, with cross-references and updated catalogs for precise part selection.

productsAndServices.description: Integration of multiple payment systems including Visa, MasterCard, local banks, and cash terminals to facilitate online transactions for automotive parts sales.

productsAndServices.description: A service to upload and manage price lists for sale on the seller’s own website and partner webshops within the automotive parts ecosystem.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $500,000, or 27.78% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,464,538 to $15,500,000, a 4.47x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
